description: This PHP source file defines the class QuotesParseRule, which extends BaseRule and implements custom parsing logic for quote-related views in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for pre-processing panel layouts in DetailView and EditView contexts, adjusting or replacing certain address and field labels and values based on regex matching.
